verdict.rationale: Klaviyo has a dedicated webhooks docs page with an API endpoint to list webhooks in an account, so account-level webhook objects are a first-party capability. However, the evidence never explicitly documents creating or registering a webhook, choosing event topics, or what the delivered payload looks like. Missing for 10: documented webhook creation/registration endpoint, event topic subscription options, payload/signature/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
